name: zmodel_set_software_path_active
description: zModel::SetSoftwarePathActive records the model software-path activity flag only while the active renderer path is software.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this zModel leaf setter; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zModel initialization/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x476020 validates a leaf fastcall function that reads g_zVideo_ActiveRendererPath, writes the ECX active value to g_zModel_SoftwarePathActive only when the renderer path is zero, and returns without side effects otherwise.
The native smoke verifies software-renderer updates, signed value preservation, and hardware-renderer skip behavior.
